verdict.rationale: Bulk operations, such as a batch inference API or bulk management actions, are a fair question for an LLM API gateway, so the axis applies. The evidence pack documents no bulk or batch capability. The models fallback array, load balancing and programmatic key management are adjacent features that act on one request or one key at a time, not bulk operations across many items.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once
